m: Cook the brown rice (25 to 30 minutes).
Fry the lemongrass and garlic in a little oil for 30 seconds, then add the chicken mince. Break it up and cook 5 to 6 minutes until cooked and a little golden.
Off the heat, stir in the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and sliced chilli. Taste: it should be sour, salty and hot.
Toss through the thinly sliced red onion and a big handful of torn mint and coriander.
Separate the iceberg into cups and slice the cucumber.
Spoon the larb into the lettuce cups, with rice and cucumber on the side.
l: Pack the larb with rice, lettuce leaves in a separate bag to stay crisp.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the fish sauce.
